# J.S. Warden

> Dark LitRPG and fantasy noir by J.S. Warden — books, in-world field dispatches, character profiles, and free browser tabletop tools.

## About & Authority

- **Author:** J.S. Warden is the fiction pen name of Josh, published by **Built by Josh Studio LLC** (`https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt`).
- **Official Profiles:** [About the Creator](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/about.html) | [Amazon Author Page](https://www.amazon.com/stores/author/B0FPQ3RWWF) | [Tales of Ink & Shadows on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@TalesofInkShadowsStudio)
- **Contact:** `support@builtbyjoshstudio.com`
- **Privacy & Tool Architecture:** All tabletop tools at `/tabletop/` are free, ad-free, require no signup, run locally in the browser, and store user data (encounters, roll histories, campaign journals, custom tables, and kept lists) only in browser `localStorage`. Nothing entered is uploaded to a server.
- **Fuller Index:** [https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms-full.txt](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms-full.txt)

## Tabletop tools

- [Initiative Tracker | Free TTRPG Combat Tracker, Any System](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/initiative-tracker/): Track turn order, rounds, HP, and conditions for any tabletop RPG combat — D&D, Pathfinder, or homebrew. Saves between sessions. Free, no ads.
- [Dice Roller | Free Online RPG Dice with Notation & History](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/dice-roller/): Roll d4 to d100 with full dice notation — 3d6+2, 4d6 keep highest 3, advantage and disadvantage. Roll history included. Free, ad-free, no signup.
- [Session Notes & NPC Log | Free TTRPG Campaign Journal](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/session-notes/): Keep session notes, NPC names, and loot for your TTRPG campaign — saved in your browser between sessions, exportable to Markdown. Free, ad-free, no signup.
- [Wargame Score Tracker | Free VP & CP Tracker, Any System](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/wargame-score-tracker/): Track victory points, command points, secondaries, and battle rounds for two players in any miniature wargame. Saves mid-game. Free, ad-free, no signup.
- [Random Table Roller | Roll on Your Own Custom TTRPG Tables](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/random-table-roller/): Paste or build your own random tables — d20 taverns, d100 loot — then roll on them with one tap. Weighted ranges, saved tables. Free, ad-free, no signup.
- [Fantasy Character Name Generator | Free, Any Style](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/character-name-generator/): Generate original fantasy character names in four styles — flowing, guttural, short, or noble. Six fresh names per click, save favorites. Free.
- [NPC Generator | Name, Quirk, Motivation & Secret, Free](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/npc-generator/): Generate a complete NPC in one click — name, occupation, quirk, motivation, and a secret. Sends straight to your session notes. Free, ad-free, any system.
- [Tavern Generator | Name, Patrons, Rumor & Menu, Free](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/tavern-generator/): Generate a complete fantasy tavern in one click — name, atmosphere, a patron worth talking to, tonight's rumor, and what's on the menu. Free, ad-free.
- [Plot Hook Generator | One-Line Adventure Hooks with a Twist](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/plot-hook-generator/): Generate one-line adventure hooks with a built-in twist — session starters for any tabletop RPG. One click, keep the good ones. Free, ad-free.
- [Loot Generator | Flavorful Treasure Without the Stat Blocks](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/loot-generator/): Generate flavorful, system-free treasure in one click — objects with texture and history, no rules text. Perfect for any tabletop RPG. Free, ad-free.
